# Emoji images

`1f62d.png` (loudly crying face) and `1f494.png` (broken heart) are Apple's emoji
artwork, 64 px, taken from the `emoji-datasource-apple` npm package (v15.1.2).

The artwork is copyright Apple Inc. and Apple licenses it for use on Apple
platforms only. It is included here at the project owner's request and risk.
Swap these two files for original art (or an openly licensed set such as
Twemoji or Noto) if that ever needs to change; the game only reads them by
codepoint from this folder.
